fontFamilies.display: DMSerif, Georgia, serif (DM Serif — modern transitional, free Google Font)
fontFamilies.note: Bader использует DM Serif для display — это современный transitional serif с лёгким editorial feel. Свободная Google Font, доступна с cyrillic.

colors.accent-blush: видно на скрине — мягкий персиковый/blush для CTA-кнопок
colors.section-tinted: тёмный navy / black секции на dark-mode spreads

layout.approach: Long-scroll с 12+ editorial spreads. Asymmetry — есть split-secrets (text/image), есть full-bleed dark spreads (Science of TFC8), есть product cards 3-up.
sections_observed: Hero (split: product image left, brand-statement right)
The Science of TFC8 (dark spread, large numbers)

patterns: Серo-белая base + dark inverse spreads через каждые 3-4 секции (rhythm)
Product cards: photo + name + benefit + price + SHOP NOW button (sans-serif heavy)
Founder portrait: B&W photo left, blush bg + serif H2 right + text + CTA — split asymmetric
Numbered editorial (1-2-3) для key claims на dark surface
Multi-column body text spreads (4 columns! на 1440)
Blush/peach #F4E5D9-ish CTA buttons на dark backgrounds — единственный warm accent
Footer: deep dark navy, dense links 4 columns + SOC links + payments
